title: rotation-coordinator: staged, rollback-safe KMS/HSM rotation + terraform/helm upgrade hooks
author: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Introduces a small controller (rotation-coordinator) and accompanying Terraform and Helm changes to orchestrat e staged TLS/key rotations across Vault, external KMS plugins, and HSM-backed keywraps. The goal is to provide an upgrade-safe workflow that can perform rolling rotations with automatic health checks and deterministic rollback in case of failures.

Motivation and context: Customers running Redwood Private need deterministic, auditable key rotations across mixed secret backends (Vault sealed secrets, external KMS plugins, HSM keywraps). Prior automation attempted one-shot rotations which risked outages during upgrades. This PR provides: staged rotation schedules, pre-upgrade checks, pre/post Helm hooks, Terraform upgrade-time hooks, and a lightweight coordinator CRD to track progress and enable safe rollback. Related Linear: ENG-4023, ENG-4071.

What this PR changes (high level):
- Adds rotation-coordinator controller (k8s controller) and CRD to the installer chart to declare rotation runs and phases.
- Helm: installer chart updated with pre-upgrade hook that validates compatibility and creates a RotationRun resource; post-upgrade hook triggers finalization.
- Terraform: new module terraform/modules/rotation_schedule to add rotation plan resources for customers using infra-as-code; includes an optional `pause_on_failure` flag which triggers an automatic rollback plan.
- Vault/SealedSecrets: secret-syncer extended to perform a staged re-encryption pass when RotationRun.phase == "rekey", and emits per-secret health checks.
- External KMS/HSM: plugin connector updated to accept a temporary dual-key envelope mode to allow side-by-side keywrap for seamless cutover.

Upgrade notes: This is backwards compatible. By default rotation-coordinator is opt-in (values.install.rotation.enabled=false). The Helm pre-upgrade hook will only create RotationRun when values.install.rotation.autostart=true. For clusters that upgrade without opting in, no new behavior occurs. For opt-in clusters, the coordinator will use a 3-phase default plan: prepare -> rekey -> verify -> commit. Each phase has timeouts and automatic rollback rules.

Rollback semantics: All rotation operations are designed to be reversible. The Terraform module outputs a rollback plan artifact (S3 path or local state) and Helm hooks annotate the release with the RotationRun ID. If any health-check fails during verify, the coordinator triggers a controlled rewrap-back to previous key material and marks the run as failed with detailed reasons.

Testing and validation: Unit tests for controller state machine included. E2E tests added to perf-canary job that performs a full rotate on a small cluster (Vault + SoftHSM) and exercises both success and induced-failure paths. Manual validation steps included in docs/rotation-coordinator.md.

Security/Audit: RotationRun is auditable and emits events to the audit-log-exporter. Temporary dual-key mode uses short-lived wrapping keys and integrates with existing KMS policies. All new network calls are behind existing RBAC rules.

Files changed (high level): see changed_files below for a representative list.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Can you document the failure modes and the exact conditions that trigger an automatic rollback?
Asha Patel: Reply: Added explicit rollback rules in state_machine.go and documented thresholds in docs/rotation-coordinator.md (see 'Failure domains' section).
Nora Kensington: Please add an option to disable dual-key mode for customers who cannot accept temporary secondary key material.
Asha Patel: Reply: Added values.install.rotation.dualKeySupport=false toggle and tests for that behaviour.
Diego Alvarez: Integration test flaked once on SoftHSM; added short retry logic to the e2e job.
Code owner (security): Approved after confirming KMS policies and audit events are present.
release_notes: Add rotation-coordinator (opt-in) to orchestrate staged TLS and key rotations across Vault, external KMS plugins, and HSM. Includes Helm/terraform hooks, rollback-safe operations, and audit events.
notes_for_ops: Default is opt-in. To enable: set values.install.rotation.enabled=true and values.install.rotation.autostart=true, run helm upgrade with the new chart and optionally create a RotationPlan CR or use the terraform module. Monitor rotation-coordinator logs and audit events in the audit-log-exporter index. In case of failures the controller will create a rollback job; manual intervention steps are in docs/rotation-coordinator.md.
testing_summary: Unit + integration coverage added for state transitions; perf-canary contains two jobs that run a full rotate and an induced-failure rotation to validate rollback. Observed average rewrap latency on SoftHSM: 120ms/secret; with AWS KMS envelope mode: 75ms/secret.
risk_assessment: Low-medium. New controller is opt-in. The dual-key mode introduces temporary additional key material; customers can opt out. Rollback paths are implemented and tested. Recommend running in staging for one rotation before enabling in prod.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps rotation enforcement out of the default upgrade path. Followup PR will add UI hooks in the console and additional analytics telemetry (ENG-4071-2).
